berries.name: CHERI
description: Blooms with delicate pretty flowers.
The bright red BERRY is very spicy.

berries.name: CHESTO
description: The BERRY's thick skin and fruit are
very tough. It is dry-tasting all over.

berries.name: PECHA
description: Very sweet and delicious.
Also very tender - handle with care.

berries.name: RAWST
description: If the leaves grow long and curly,
the BERRY seems to grow very bitter.

berries.name: ASPEAR
description: The hard BERRY is dense with a rich
juice. It is quite sour.

berries.name: LEPPA
description: Grows slower than CHERI and others.
The smaller the BERRY, the tastier.

berries.name: ORAN
description: A peculiar BERRY with a mix of flavors.
BERRIES grow in half a day.

berries.name: PERSIM
description: Loves sunlight. The BERRY's color
grows vivid when exposed to the sun.

berries.name: LUM
description: Slow to grow. If raised with loving
care, it may grow two BERRIES.

berries.name: SITRUS
description: Closely related to ORAN. The large
BERRY has a well-rounded flavor.

berries.name: FIGY
description: The BERRY, which looks chewed up,
brims with spicy substances.

berries.name: WIKI
description: The BERRY is said to have grown lumpy
to help POKéMON grip it.

berries.name: MAGO
description: The BERRY turns curvy as it grows.
The curvier, the sweeter and tastier.

berries.name: AGUAV
description: The flower is dainty. It is rare in its
ability to grow without light.

berries.name: IAPAPA
description: The BERRY is very big and sour.
It takes at least a day to grow.

berries.name: RAZZ
description: The red BERRY tastes slightly spicy.
It grows quickly in just four hours.

berries.name: BLUK
description: The BERRY is blue on the outside, but
it blackens the mouth when eaten.

berries.name: NANAB
description: This BERRY was the seventh
discovered in the world. It is sweet.

berries.name: WEPEAR
description: The flower is small and white. It has a
delicate balance of bitter and sour.

berries.name: PINAP
description: Weak against wind and cold.
The fruit is spicy and the skin, sour.

berries.name: POMEG
description: However much it is watered,
it only grows up to six BERRIES.

berries.name: KELPSY
description: A rare variety shaped like a root.
Grows a very large flower.

berries.name: QUALOT
description: Loves water. Grows strong even in
locations with constant rainfall.

berries.name: HONDEW
description: A BERRY that is very valuable and
rarely seen. It is very delicious.

berries.name: GREPA
description: Despite its tenderness and round
shape, the BERRY is unimaginably sour.

berries.name: TAMATO
description: The BERRY is lip-bendingly spicy.
It takes time to grow.

berries.name: CORNN
description: A BERRY from an ancient era. May not
grow unless planted in quantity.

berries.name: MAGOST
description: A BERRY that is widely said to have
a finely balanced flavor.

berries.name: RABUTA
description: A rare variety that is overgrown with
hair. It is quite bitter.

berries.name: NOMEL
description: Quite sour. Just one bite makes it
impossible to taste for three days.

berries.name: SPELON
description: The vividly red BERRY is very spicy.
Its warts secrete a spicy substance.

berries.name: PAMTRE
description: Drifts on the sea from somewhere.
It is thought to grow elsewhere.

berries.name: WATMEL
description: A huge BERRY, with some over 20
inches discovered. Exceedingly sweet.

berries.name: DURIN
description: Bitter to even look at. It is so
bitter, no one has ever eaten it as is.

berries.name: BELUE
description: It is glossy and looks delicious, but
it is awfully sour. Takes time to grow.

berries.name: LIECHI
description: A mysterious BERRY. It is rumored to
contain the power of the sea.

berries.name: GANLON
description: A mysterious BERRY. It is rumored to
contain the power of the land.

berries.name: SALAC
description: A mysterious BERRY. It is rumored to
contain the power of the sky.

berries.name: PETAYA
description: A mysterious BERRY. It is rumored to
contain the power of all living things.

berries.name: APICOT
description: A very mystifying BERRY. No telling
what may happen or how it can be used.

berries.name: LANSAT
description: Said to be a legendary BERRY.
Holding it supposedly brings joy.

berries.name: STARF
description: So strong, it was abandoned at the
world's edge. Considered a mirage.

berries.name: ENIGMA
description: A completely enigmatic BERRY.
Appears to have the power of stars.
